source.name: CCEE open data, PLD_HORARIO
source.attribution: Câmara de Comercialização de Energia Elétrica (CCEE)
source.unit: R$/MWh (unit not stated on the dataset page)

contract.says: Each file has the 6 columns MES_REFERENCIA, SUBMERCADO, PERIODO_COMERCIALIZACAO, DIA, HORA, PLD_HORA
MES_REFERENCIA is a month (YYYYMM) in the file's year
SUBMERCADO is one of NORDESTE, NORTE, SUDESTE, SUL
DIA is a day that exists in that month
HORA is a whole hour from 0 to 23
PERIODO_COMERCIALIZACAO equals (DIA - 1) x 24 + HORA + 1, the hour count within the month
PLD_HORA is a number with at most two decimals, dot as decimal mark
PLD_HORA is between 1 and 5,000 R$/MWh (sanity bounds)
Each month, submarket, day and hour appears once across all files
Every submarket has exactly the 24 hours 0 to 23 on every day (a 23- or 25-hour daylight-saving day fails)
Every day and hour has a price for all four submarkets
Every calendar day from 2021-01-01 to the newest day is present
The newest priced day is at most 3 days before the retrieval date
